matching: Confidence-ordered greedy one-to-one same-class IoU>=0.5; box and mask matched separately.
mask_coordinates: Default predictor masks; scale_masks removes padding, bilinear upsample to original H/W, threshold>0.5. GT polygon vertices rounded to original pixels.
limitations: Train predictions diagnose fit to known images, not generalization.
Five val images and one physical item per class; threshold diagnostics are not AP or broad accuracy.
Low-threshold filters reuse the same post-NMS pool (max_det=300); raw scores separately inspect pre-NMS candidates.
No other milk brand negatives, systematic illumination/occlusion groups or sealed-test predictions.

M3_05_acceptance.scope: Available train/val error analysis completed; display quality still insufficient and missing stress-test categories recorded.

conclusions: At conf=.25 all 30 training targets match both box and mask IoU>=.5, with zero unmatched predictions; validation matches 4/8. Training fit is already strong, with a substantial scene-generalization gap.

Val001/002 Yili correct-class pre-NMS scores at overlapping boxes peak at .000607/.000597. They are lost even before the .001 candidate cutoff; evidence does not support milk-class swap or NMS as the main cause.
Val004 small Sam is localized and segmented well (box .807, mask .892), but score .116 is below .25. Val001 Sam also has poor mask IoU .389 at a .00653 candidate.
Val004 Yili mask IoU .598 and area 1.564 times GT: it passes coarse .5 matching, while visible background spill remains important. Fixed-threshold success is not accurate contour recovery.
Lowering .25 to .05 gains only one true positive and adds six false positives. It is a diagnostic, not an accepted model improvement.

Prioritize a same-data controlled augmentation experiment covering greater milk carton rotation and size changes; retain E1 and fixed val/test roles. Extra epochs alone are not the first remedy, and synthetic rotation cannot replace new physical viewpoints/backgrounds.

If same-data improvements are insufficient, consider only 6-8 targeted new training photos of flat/oblique cartons and smaller cartons on different backgrounds, within the remaining 20-photo allowance. This experiment and photography are proposals, not executed.
